profile.bio: Two heavy sentences: what you shoot, and why it matters. The photographs in this starter are museum Open Access samples and cannot be published as your work.

blocks.text: A photographer of the far West — rivers, domes, and the roads that barely reach them.
Prints and books ship each month — write for the current list.

blocks.text: The full set — three to a row, captions on hover.

01-river-view-down-valley-cathedral-rock.title: River View Down Valley, Cathedral Rock on Left
01-river-view-down-valley-cathedral-rock.alt: Still water reflects tall pines while pale Yosemite cliffs recede into haze.
01-river-view-down-valley-cathedral-rock.description: Carleton E. Watkins. River View Down Valley, Cathedral Rock on Left, 1861. The Metropolitan Museum of Art.

02-yosemite-falls-river-view-2637-feet.j.title: Yosemite Falls, River View, 2637 Feet
02-yosemite-falls-river-view-2637-feet.j.alt: A broad granite ridge rises beyond a riverbank crowded with dark conifers.
02-yosemite-falls-river-view-2637-feet.j.description: Carleton E. Watkins. Yosemite Falls, River View, 2637 Feet, 1861. The Metropolitan Museum of Art.

03-tutucanula-el-capitan-4000-feet.jpg.title: Tutucanula, El Capitan, 4000 Feet
03-tutucanula-el-capitan-4000-feet.jpg.alt: El Capitan towers above a quiet river and a low band of pine trees.
03-tutucanula-el-capitan-4000-feet.jpg.description: Carleton E. Watkins. Tutucanula, El Capitan, 4000 Feet, 1861. The Metropolitan Museum of Art.

01-cascade-nevada-fall-on-left-view-abov.title: Cascade, Nevada Fall on Left, View above Vernal Fall
01-cascade-nevada-fall-on-left-view-abov.alt: White water runs through smooth granite shelves beneath a dense stand of pines.
01-cascade-nevada-fall-on-left-view-abov.description: Carleton E. Watkins. Cascade, Nevada Fall on Left, View above Vernal Fall, 1861. The Metropolitan Museum of Art.

02-cathedral-rock.jpg.title: Cathedral Rock
02-cathedral-rock.jpg.alt: The sheer face of Cathedral Rock fills the frame above a line of conifers.
02-cathedral-rock.jpg.description: Carleton E. Watkins. Cathedral Rock, 1861. The Metropolitan Museum of Art.

03-view-on-the-columbia-cascades.jpg.title: View on the Columbia, Cascades
03-view-on-the-columbia-cascades.jpg.alt: The Columbia River bends past wooded banks toward faint mountains on the horizon.
03-view-on-the-columbia-cascades.jpg.description: Carleton E. Watkins. View on the Columbia, Cascades, 1867. The Metropolitan Museum of Art.

01-lower-yosemite-falls.jpg.title: Lower Yosemite Falls
01-lower-yosemite-falls.jpg.alt: A bright vertical waterfall cuts through a shadowed wall of rock and trees.
01-lower-yosemite-falls.jpg.description: Carleton E. Watkins. Lower Yosemite Falls, 1860s. The Metropolitan Museum of Art.

01-cape-horn-near-celilo.jpg.title: Cape Horn near Celilo
01-cape-horn-near-celilo.jpg.alt: A massive column of rock rises beside a river and a straight rail line.
01-cape-horn-near-celilo.jpg.description: Carleton E. Watkins. Cape Horn near Celilo, 1867. The Metropolitan Museum of Art.

02-mount-shasta-from-the-north.jpg.title: Mount Shasta from the North
02-mount-shasta-from-the-north.jpg.alt: Snow-covered Mount Shasta rises above a dark open plain and distant tree line.
02-mount-shasta-from-the-north.jpg.description: Carleton E. Watkins. Mount Shasta from the North, 1870. The Metropolitan Museum of Art.

03-the-domes-from-sentinel-dome.jpg.title: The Domes from Sentinel Dome
03-the-domes-from-sentinel-dome.jpg.alt: A sunlit granite dome rises beyond forested slopes viewed from a high ridge.
03-the-domes-from-sentinel-dome.jpg.description: Carleton E. Watkins. The Domes from Sentinel Dome, 1866. The Metropolitan Museum of Art.

04-river-view-down-valley-cathedral-rock.title: River View Down Valley, Cathedral Rock on Left
04-river-view-down-valley-cathedral-rock.alt: Still water reflects tall pines while pale Yosemite cliffs recede into haze.
04-river-view-down-valley-cathedral-rock.description: Carleton E. Watkins. River View Down Valley, Cathedral Rock on Left, 1861. The Metropolitan Museum of Art.

05-cathedral-rock.jpg.title: Cathedral Rock
05-cathedral-rock.jpg.alt: The sheer face of Cathedral Rock fills the frame above a line of conifers.
05-cathedral-rock.jpg.description: Carleton E. Watkins. Cathedral Rock, 1861. The Metropolitan Museum of Art.

06-view-on-the-columbia-cascades.jpg.title: View on the Columbia, Cascades
06-view-on-the-columbia-cascades.jpg.alt: The Columbia River bends past wooded banks toward faint mountains on the horizon.
06-view-on-the-columbia-cascades.jpg.description: Carleton E. Watkins. View on the Columbia, Cascades, 1867. The Metropolitan Museum of Art.
